title: A new race of 135 km, merging the QMT-100 miles and the QMT-110
claims: The organiser announced that from 2025 a new 135 km race would merge the QMT100 Miles (160 km) and QMT110, start in Baie-Saint-Paul and finish at Mont-Sainte-Anne with a new section on the Sentier des Caps through Cap Brûlé.
The announcement gives 6,000 m of gain, a cut-off set at 32 hours and 10 aid stations for the new race.
The announcement says the new race would join the World Trail Majors in place of the 100 miles, be a Western States 100 qualifier and earn finishers 5 ITRA points.
